therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: VAC (Vincristine, Dactinomycin, Cyclophosphamide) vs VAC alternating with VI (Vincristine, Irinotecan)
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: DNA synthesis and cell division machinery
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: DNA alkylation, topoisomerase inhibition, and microtubule disruption

biomarker_changes: FDG PET SUVmax changes: ≥40% reduction at week 4 associated with better EFS (0.6364 vs 0.2857)
PAX3 fusion associated with worse EFS (0.51) compared to PAX7 (0.66)
subgroup_findings: UGT1A1 genotype 7/7 associated with increased diarrhea risk with VI treatment (p=0.036)
PAX3 vs PAX7 fusion status affects EFS
safety_signals: Higher grade 3-4 toxicity with VAC+VI (36.7%) vs VAC alone (20.7%)
Febrile neutropenia: VAC 13.5%, diarrhea more common with VI
Bladder dysfunction: 2 patients VAC, 1 patient VAC+VI
results.dose_information: Standard VAC regimen with early radiotherapy at week 4, alternating with VI in experimental arm

context.duration: 4 years follow-up, treatment up to 43 weeks
